professionalSummary.text: Platform engineer with three years of end-to-end ownership of a commercial bank's credit workflow system runtime platform on Kubernetes, including production configuration changes, infrastructure code, and change management.
professionalSummary.witness: Owned the runtime platform for the credit workflow system for three years, deciding and executing production configuration changes to the Kubernetes clusters myself as the platform's named owner, with the change record carrying my approval and my execution.

experienceHighlights.text: Decided and executed production configuration changes to Kubernetes clusters as the named owner, with change records showing approval and execution under the candidate's user ID.
experienceHighlights.witness: Owned the runtime platform for the credit workflow system for three years, deciding and executing production configuration changes to the Kubernetes clusters myself as the platform's named owner, with the change record carrying my approval and my execution.

experienceHighlights.text: Built and maintained infrastructure code (Terraform, Helm charts) and deployment pipelines for the workflow application's promotion through environments.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built and maintained the platform's infrastructure code (Terraform, Helm charts) and the deployment pipelines that promote the workflow application through test, staging and production.

experienceHighlights.text: Led weekly platform change reviews, deciding on scheduling and recording decisions in the change-review log.
experienceHighlights.witness: Led the weekly platform change review, deciding which application and platform changes were scheduled into the production window and recording the decisions in the change-review log.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated changes with application team and security, documenting ownership boundaries (application team: application config, security: policy baseline, candidate: cluster config and production window).
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated changes with the application team and security, recording that the application team owned application configuration and security owned the policy baseline while I owned the cluster configuration and the production window.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented runbooks, limitations, and hand-over conditions for platform changes as part of the change management process.
experienceHighlights.witness: Responsibilities included platform ownership, production change decisions and execution, infrastructure code, pipelines and the weekly change review over about three years.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Verified platform ownership and change execution via engineering service catalogue entry and one month of change records showing candidate's user ID and change tool identifiers.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the platform ownership entry in the engineering service catalogue and the change records for one month showing approval and execution under the candidate's user id, with the change tool's identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Kubernetes platform management, infrastructure as code (Terraform, Helm), deployment pipelines, change management, cross-functional coordination.
skills.witness: Built and maintained the platform's infrastructure code (Terraform, Helm charts) and the deployment pipelines that promote the workflow application through test, staging and production.
